name: mnada
description: Mnada – monolithic app (API + client), Supabase DB

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.prisma:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
